speaker: Joseph Ayanda, natural speaking voice; one speaker only
recording_rule: One continuous recording. Speak naturally. Leave about 0.8-1.2 seconds between quoted utterances and about 1.5 seconds after a confirmation/discard. Do not imitate synthetic or foreign-accent speech. No background music. Ordinary room noise is allowed.
evaluation_policy: Run once after the post-holdout code revision is merged/deployed. Do not alter code, thresholds, expected answers or recording after first listening. Preserve failures. Any further code change requires another unseen recording before a new human-performance claim.
safety_expectations: Beans six cartons never changes the earlier confirmed beans count.
Confirm six cannot rescue a wrong-unit beans draft.
Confirm thirteen cannot commit a pending rice count of thirty one.
Discard count clears the unconfirmed rice-thirty-one draft without changing confirmed rice twenty-two.
The later soap zero count replaces the earlier confirmed soap nine only after confirm zero.
limitations: One scripted speaker/session is integration evidence, not population-level Nigerian-accent accuracy, shopkeeper usability, or calibrated ASR performance.
